title: 第17章 绝命毒圣第18章 异象甩锅
slug: 大楚第一探花开局卧底女魔头
content_zh:
商玄镜和霜儿纷纷神色诡异地看向宋牧驰。
商玄镜原本打算表露身份跟这白胖子谈判交易，珍宝阁阁主能动用的能量和资源任谁都要考虑一二。
只不过她担心对方不按常理出牌，有些后果她很难接受。
哪里知道竟然会有这样的变故？
霜儿忍不住说道：“你刚刚一直说的绝色美人难道是说他？”
那表情简直有些怀疑人生了。
“说的不是他难道还是你们啊？”白胖子翻了个白眼，“你俩也许在其他男人眼中是美人儿，但对我来说没有任何意义，还比不上这位小兄弟一根手指。”
商玄镜和霜儿此时脸色古怪极了，若是平日里被人这样说，她们恐怕早就气炸了，但此时却有一种莫名的庆幸之感。
想笑，又不好意思笑。
这时茜茜却忍不住了：“哥哥很漂亮，可是娘亲和霜儿姐姐明明也很漂亮啊。”
“茜茜别胡说。”商玄镜一时间也不知道该如何跟女儿解释，不想污染她那颗童真的心。
宋牧驰：“……”
他此时内心当真是有万千匹草泥马奔腾而过。
刚刚看到这家伙圆脸络腮胡，就想到了穿越前网上看到的那些成都林心如，不过对方显然是顶尖高手，他就没有多想。
现在不得不感叹那些刻板印象实在太精准了。
他想到刚刚自己逞英雄说有什么都冲我来，就恨不得给自己两个大嘴巴子。
“大哥，误会误会，我其实也没那么好，长得又瘦又没络腮胡，我倒是认识几个你们圈子里的绝色，要不带你去找他们？”
“哦？是么？”那白胖络腮胡眼前一亮，似乎来了兴趣，不过很快摇了摇头，“可惜我如今有要事在身。”
说话间他已经跳到了马车上，随手一挥，一股劲力将商玄镜和霜儿几人给扫到了车厢之中，他则在宋牧驰身边坐了下来。
宋牧驰急忙努力朝旁边挪了挪身子，只可惜如今中了毒，实在没什么力气。

看到他努力离对方远一些的模样，后面的三女只觉得又想笑又担心。
宋牧驰此时真是紧张到了极点，他前世逛某乎，有个小说话题中提到，让女主角断手断脚甚至死亡都没啥问题，因为一些仙侠背景，完全可以让她们复原，但唯一不能让女主角失贞，哪怕仙侠世界有各种的神奇的术法能让其恢复如初，依然是剧毒。
同样的男主角可以受尽无数身体上的伤与痛苦，唯独不能被刚，不然哪怕大复原术都救不了。
士可杀不可辱！
不过倒也不是完全没有机会，虽然两种异象帮不了忙，不过之前那张圣旨还有一击之力……
幸好这时那白胖络腮胡忽然开口道：“可惜时间紧迫，等会儿再跟美人儿温存。”
旋即直接挥动缰绳驾驶着马车朝远处开去。
“你要的只是我而已，又何必牵连其他人，把她们放了吧。”宋牧驰沉声道，事已至此，能救一个是一个。
刚刚跟茜茜短暂的相处，已经喜欢上了天真可爱的她，不忍她遭受什么不幸。
另外让商玄镜欠一个人情，也算结个善缘。
霜儿急忙看向商玄镜，此时眉宇间尽是焦急之色，没想到这个家伙竟然这个时候都还想着救她们，自己之前竟然还觉得他卑鄙无耻。
商玄镜也是眼神微动，多年冰封的内心此时忽然生出了一缕微不可察的松动。
“阁下若是愿意放过我们与宋公子，我可以另外给你提供千名美少年作为补偿。”她顿了顿，继续说道，“我还可以帮你完成各种愿望，这世上我做不到的事情并不多。”
宋牧驰忍不住看了她一眼，没想到她竟然会为自己求情。
content_en:
Shang Xuanjing and Shuang'er looked at Song Muchi with strange expressions.
Shang Xuanjing originally planned to reveal his identity and negotiate a deal with this fat man. Everyone had to consider the energy and resources that the master of the Treasure Pavilion could use.
It's just that she is worried that the other party will not act according to common sense, and some consequences will be difficult for her to accept.
How did you know that there would be such a change?
Shuang'er couldn't help but said: "Is the stunning beauty you just been talking about referring to him?"
That expression was almost suspicious of life.
"Isn't he talking about you?" Fatty Bai rolled his eyes. "You two may be beautiful in the eyes of other men, but it means nothing to me. You are not as good as a finger of this little brother."
Shang Xuanjing and Shuang'er's expressions were extremely strange at this time. If they were said like this on normal days, they would have exploded with rage, but now they felt an inexplicable sense of joy.
I want to laugh, but I am embarrassed to laugh.
At this time, Sissi couldn't help it anymore: "My brother is very beautiful, but my mother and sister Shuang'er are also very beautiful."
"Qianxi, don't talk nonsense." Shang Xuanjing didn't know how to explain to his daughter for a while, not wanting to pollute her innocent heart.
Song Muchi: "..."
At this moment, there were really thousands of grass and mud horses galloping past him.
When he saw this guy's round face and beard, he thought of the Chengdu Lin Xinru he had seen on the Internet before traveling. However, the other person was obviously a top expert, so he didn't think much about it.
Now I have to lament that those stereotypes are so accurate.
He thought about how he had just acted like a hero and said that he would come at me if he had anything, and he wanted to give himself two big mouths.
"Brother, there's a misunderstanding. I'm actually not that good. I'm thin and beardless. I do know a few stunning beauties in your circle. Why don't I take you to find them?"
"Oh? Really?" The fat white bearded man's eyes lit up, and he seemed to be interested, but he quickly shook his head, "It's a pity that I have something important to do now."
While he was talking, he had already jumped onto the carriage, and with a wave of his hand, a force swept Shang Xuanjing and Shuang'er into the carriage, and he sat down next to Song Muchi.
Song Muchi hurriedly tried his best to move to the side, but unfortunately he was poisoned now and really had no strength.
Seeing him trying to stay away from each other, the three women behind him felt both want to laugh and worry at the same time.
Song Muchi was really nervous at this time. In his previous life, he visited something and mentioned in a novel topic that it would not be a problem for the heroine to have her limbs amputated or even die, because some fairy tale backgrounds can completely restore them, but the only thing that cannot be done is to make the heroine lose her virginity. Even if there are various magical spells in the fairy tale world to restore her to the original state, it is still highly poisonous.
The same male protagonist can suffer countless physical injuries and pains, but he cannot be killed, otherwise even the Great Restoration Technique will not be able to save him.
Scholars can be killed but not humiliated!
But it's not that there's no chance at all. Although the two visions can't help, the previous imperial edict still has the power to strike...
Fortunately, at this time, the fat white man with beard suddenly said: "It's a pity that time is tight. I can be gentle with the beauty later."
Immediately, he waved the reins and drove the carriage towards the distance.
"It's just me you want, so why bother involving other people? Just let them go." Song Muchi said in a deep voice. The matter has come to this, and every one can be saved.
I just got along with Sissi for a short time, and I have already fallen in love with her innocent and cute nature, and I can't bear any misfortune to her.
In addition, letting Shang Xuanjing owe a favor can also be regarded as a good relationship.
Shuang'er hurriedly looked at Shang Xuanjing, with a look of anxiety on her brows. She didn't expect that this guy was still thinking about saving them at this time. She had thought he was despicable before.
Shang Xuanjing's eyes also moved slightly, and his heart that had been frozen for many years suddenly felt a little unnoticeable.
"If your Excellency is willing to let us and Mr. Song go, I can provide you with another thousand beautiful young men.years as compensation. She paused and continued, "I can also help you fulfill all your wishes. There are not many things in this world that I can't do." "
Song Muchi couldn't help but glance at her, but he didn't expect that she would plead for him.
